senses.gloss: [duhatṛ- for duhitṛ-, which doubtless read, daughter: cakravarti-duhatābhūt Gv 〔269.14〕, and ˚duhatur 17; duhitā, regularly, 〔275.11〕 etc.]
duhitṛkā (= Skt. duhitṛ plus -ka, here ifc. Bhvr.; cf. Schmidt, Nachträge, s.v.), daughter: apagata-putraduhitṛkā (Māyā) LV 〔26.16〕 (prose).

duhitrī (〔§ 13.15〕) = duhitṛ, daughter: ˚tryoḥ, gen. dual (or, with v.l., ˚tryāḥ, gen. sg.), Divy 〔392.10〕 (prose); ˚tryā, instr. sg., 〔402.1〕 (prose); ˚trīr (v.l. ˚trī), acc. pl., LV 〔301.21〕 (prose); ˚tryāḥ, gen., MSV 〔i.104.5〕.
